@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class UnicodeMetavarEllipsis(Parameter):
+    """A :class:`~click.core.Parameter` whose generated metavar uses the
+    Unicode ellipsis character (``…``) instead of three ASCII periods
+    when ``nargs`` is not 1.
+    """
+
+    def make_metavar(self, ctx: Context) -> str:
+        if self.metavar is not None:
+            return self.metavar
+
+        metavar = self.type.get_metavar(param=self, ctx=ctx)
+
+        if metavar is None:
+            metavar = self.type.name.upper()
+
+        if self.nargs != 1:
+            metavar += "…"
+
+        return metavar
